title: Our trailer updates! Feedback please. RATS!! - Co op Tower Defense
author: Masterkiefs
selftext:
Workflow: Godot CLI + Claude code. This was the primary workflow required, I also incorporated two other models (Astra & Argon), from codex and google. The code is all reviewed by astra & argon to help minimize errors, bugs and issues. I have several gate tests incorporated to help minimize bugs/errors when implementing new features

Assets: Everything you see here is written in code, no image generators were utilized for this. I did not use blender either. I focused on strictly using Godot's engine to help produce these results.

Difficulty: Bots have been implemented to help, but the only way to learn is have several of your friends try, to gamers and non gamers. It helped me uncover a lot of weak areas (such as onboarding) which was customized directly from user feedback and playtests. It also helped us uncover some towers/combos that needed better tuning as well. 

 Sound: Search for royaltyfree, CCO music, soundtracks, SFX, etc. One of my go too was freesound.

Time: I have been working on this for past couple months. The demo is pretty much polished, we are doing our last difficulty check. I am a solo developer and built this alone. The full game is being worked out, but we are really hoping for a strong demo to get as much player feedback as we can.

Thanks everyone: [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5338640/RATS_Coop_Tower_Defense/)  [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5338640/RATS\_Coop\_Tower\_Defense/https://store.steampowered.com/app/5338640/RATS\_Coop\_Tower\_Defense/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5338640/RATS_Coop_Tower_Defense/https://store.steampowered.com/app/5338640/RATS_Coop_Tower_Defense/)

Please any feedback is awesome!!

comments.author: aarontrimble
comments.body: I like the co-op for tower defense.

replies.author: Masterkiefs
replies.body:
Ayy thanks!! Added some fun mechanics too it.

Always love gaming with my buddies so I built co op and PvP as our primary focus!  
\- cool mechanic you can save your friends when their trampled  
\- launch them via catapult style  
\- face eachother  
\- sack toss (the item the rats steal) can be tossed to your friends.

And more!! Start small and wait for player feedback, don’t wanna add to much either to confuse players
